_comment: DeckProbe project config for ShelvesHub. DeckProbe (submodule at ./deckprobe) loads this file plus .env (DECK_CDP_HOST / DECK_CDP_PORT, default port 8081) to run CDP probes / diags / screenshots against a live Steam Deck. Drive it via the pnpm deck:probe, deck:diag, deck:screenshot, and deck:perf scripts. Every value here is overridable through DECKPROBE_* environment variables.
